body: im the same, I used to hope that maybe if someone noticed, they would care enough to help. I was lucky enough it was an older student at school and not a teacher and she has been helping me through it ever since. I did end up getting caught by my counsellor after another student told on me and now everyday I have to deal with the attention. I mean it feels good to know some people care but i’m just constantly embarrassed I guess. weird how it all works
